protocol.primary: mathematics+physics -> coding: composition masked normalized transition MSE

qualification_gates.execution_and_independent_replay: All targets finite and independently reproduced; all valid tasks solvable by verified procedural executor, all identities/splits disjoint; every coding target requires real WASI execution. No qualification task replacement.
qualification_gates.composition_policy: Composition targets are sealed as opaque hashes and not read for qualification or training. No held-out model performance is used for task selection.

protocol.decision: Any qualification gate failure -> DATA_NO_GO and stop before neural execution. Any scientific gate failure -> NO_GO and stop; pass -> GO_TO_INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION only. No extra seed, tuning, candidate expansion or budget increase.
protocol.budget: Nine fits per target? No: three targets x three learned conditions x three seeds = 27 fits; exactly 120 updates x 16 graphs per fit. First 60 updates: domain-only repeats target labels, shared/randomized alternate two source domains; final 60 use same first 12 target tasks. Randomized condition permutes source targets/validity within source domain, preserving input graphs. Same architecture and initial weights per seed; domain dimensions and active entities cause measured compute differences.
protocol.scope: Fresh bounded register updates, small AST literal edits and one-step physical impulses. This is a new transition-generation mechanism, not specialist candidate scoring. No Qwen, backbone training or old sealed holdout access. Expert procedural executor can be perfect on this intentionally executable microdomain; headroom is over persistence, not that expert. Procedural ceiling must be reported. Synthetic task design is disclosed; coding and physics outcomes are actual independent runtime/simulator outputs. No whole-program-repair, numerical-rule-induction or general-physics claim.
protocol.mask_policy: Only public observed values and public actions enter graph inputs. Missing/hidden values must be zeroed and accompanied by masks. Physics study uses fully observed parameters; no claim of hidden-state inference. Targets occur only after execution.
protocol.composition_split: Train/qualification: two math registers, one binary coding AST, one physical object. Held-out: three registers, two-level coding AST, two physical objects. Also fresh operands/literals/scene seeds. Zero-update performance recorded before fit; training curves and per-seed outcomes use same frozen identities.

information: Graphs computed only from public inputs; targets independently executed afterward.
historical_scope: New V5 microtasks; no historical sealed task files read. Domain-qualified identities differ from V3/V4 task schemas.
